fixed.explanation: Both expires and max-age write cookie.expires in order, so the last wins. Track maxAge separately and apply it after the loop so it takes precedence. Also require Max-Age to match /^-?\d+$/ per RFC 6265 5.2.2, otherwise ignore it.

query.intent: The Set-Cookie parsing code in the API request context (parseCookie) handles the Max-Age and Expires attributes in order, both writing the same expires field so the last wins. It must make Max-Age take precedence regardless of order, and ignore Max-Age values that are not purely digits (optionally with a leading minus per RFC).
query.symptom: A cookie with Max-Age followed by a past Expires is stored as expired and not sent, and a non-numeric Max-Age like "10abc" is parsed as a number instead of being ignored.
